name: weapon_deagle
title: Desert Eagle
description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range.

name: weapon_elite
title: Dual Berettas
description: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once.

name: weapon_fiveseven
title: Five-SeveN
description: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil.

name: weapon_glock
title: Glock-18
description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts.

name: weapon_ak47
title: AK-47
description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire.

name: weapon_aug
title: AUG
description: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire.

name: weapon_awp
title: AWP
description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy.

name: weapon_famas
title: FAMAS
description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs.

name: weapon_g3sg1
title: G3SG1
description: The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles.

name: weapon_galilar
title: Galil AR
description: A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat.

name: weapon_m249
title: M249
description: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity.

name: weapon_m4a1
title: M4A4
description: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs.

name: weapon_mac10
title: MAC-10
description: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs.

name: weapon_p90
title: P90
description: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil.

name: weapon_mp5sd
title: MP5-SD
description: Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet.

name: weapon_ump45
title: UMP-45
description: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic.

name: weapon_xm1014
title: XM1014
description: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast.

name: weapon_bizon
title: PP-Bizon
description: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly.

name: weapon_mag7
title: MAG-7
description: The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice.

name: weapon_negev
title: Negev
description: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it.

name: weapon_sawedoff
title: Sawed-Off
description: The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit.

name: weapon_tec9
title: Tec-9
description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity.

name: weapon_taser
title: Zeus x27
description: Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit.

name: weapon_hkp2000
title: P2000
description: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents.

name: weapon_mp7
title: MP7
description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat.

name: weapon_mp9
title: MP9
description: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms.

name: weapon_nova
title: Nova
description: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team.

name: weapon_p250
title: P250
description: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents.

name: weapon_scar20
title: SCAR-20
description: The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag.

name: weapon_sg556
title: SG 553
description: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement.

name: weapon_ssg08
title: SSG 08
description: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship.

name: weapon_knifegg
title: Knife
description: Quiet and always available, the knife has a fast, low-damage primary attack and a slow, high-damage secondary attack. A backstab will earn quiet players an instant kill.

name: weapon_knife
title: Knife
description: Quiet and always available, the knife has a fast, low-damage primary attack and a slow, high-damage secondary attack. A backstab will earn quiet players an instant kill.

name: weapon_flashbang
title: Flashbang
description: The non-lethal flashbang grenade temporarily blinds anybody within its concussive blast, making it perfect for flushing out closed-in areas. Its loud explosion also temporarily masks the sound of footsteps.

name: weapon_hegrenade
title: High Explosive Grenade
description: The high explosive fragmentation grenade administers high damage through a wide area, making it ideal for clearing out hostile rooms.

name: weapon_smokegrenade
title: Smoke Grenade
description: The smoke grenade creates a medium-area smoke screen. It can effectively hide your team from snipers, or even just create a useful distraction.

name: weapon_molotov
title: Molotov
description: The Molotov is a powerful and unpredictable area denial weapon that bursts into flames when thrown on the ground, injuring any player in its radius.

name: weapon_decoy
title: Decoy Grenade
description: When thrown, the decoy grenade emulates the sound of the most powerful weapon you are carrying, creating the illusion of additional supporting forces.

name: weapon_incgrenade
title: Incendiary Grenade
description: When thrown, the incendiary grenade releases a high-temperature chemical reaction capable of burning anyone within its wide blast radius.

name: weapon_c4
title: C4 Explosive
description: Stable and resistant to most physical shocks, this improvised plastic explosive has a detonation velocity of over 8,000 meters per second when ignited.

name: weapon_healthshot
title: Medi-Shot
description: Medi-Shot

name: weapon_knife_t
title: Knife
description: Quiet and always available, the knife has a fast, low-damage primary attack and a slow, high-damage secondary attack. A backstab will earn quiet players an instant kill.

name: weapon_m4a1_silencer
title: M4A1-S
description: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy.

name: weapon_usp_silencer
title: USP-S
description: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise.

name: weapon_cz75a
title: CZ75-Auto
description: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required.

name: weapon_revolver
title: R8 Revolver
description: The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required.

name: weapon_bayonet
title: Bayonet
description: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan.

name: weapon_knife_css
title: Classic Knife
description: A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket.

name: weapon_knife_flip
title: Flip Knife
description: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable.

name: weapon_knife_gut
title: Gut Knife
description: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease.

name: weapon_knife_karambit
title: Karambit
description: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger.

name: weapon_knife_m9_bayonet
title: M9 Bayonet
description: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat.

name: weapon_knife_tactical
title: Huntsman Knife
description: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces.

name: weapon_knife_falchion
title: Falchion Knife
description: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge.

name: weapon_knife_survival_bowie
title: Bowie Knife
description: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations.

name: weapon_knife_butterfly
title: Butterfly Knife
description: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries.

name: weapon_knife_push
title: Shadow Daggers
description: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two.

name: weapon_knife_cord
title: Paracord Knife
description: This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord.

name: weapon_knife_canis
title: Survival Knife
description: This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts.

name: weapon_knife_ursus
title: Ursus Knife
description: This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work.

name: weapon_knife_gypsy_jackknife
title: Navaja Knife
description: This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade.

name: weapon_knife_outdoor
title: Nomad Knife
description: This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material.

name: weapon_knife_stiletto
title: Stiletto Knife
description: Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch.

name: weapon_knife_widowmaker
title: Talon Knife
description: This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out.

name: weapon_knife_skeleton
title: Skeleton Knife
description: This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety.

name: weapon_knife_kukri
title: Kukri Knife
description: Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings.

name: studded_bloodhound_gloves
title: Bloodhound Gloves
description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Bloodhound logo.

name: t_gloves
title: Default T Gloves
description: Never be afraid to get blood on your hands. – Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

name: ct_gloves
title: Default CT Gloves
description: General-purpose tactical combat gloves designed for military or security personnel.

name: sporty_gloves
title: Sport Gloves
description: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

name: slick_gloves
title: Driver Gloves
description: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

name: leather_handwraps
title: Hand Wraps
description: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching.

name: motorcycle_gloves
title: Moto Gloves
description: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph.

name: specialist_gloves
title: Specialist Gloves
description: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

name: studded_hydra_gloves
title: Hydra Gloves
description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo.

name: studded_brokenfang_gloves
title: Broken Fang Gloves
description: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.
